messages:
nora: starting intake for harbor9b bring-up. primary ask: prioritize latency-sensitive configs for chat use (ctx 2k) but also want a rolling quant smoke to validate int8/int4 quality. tagging infra and bench leads.

sam: ack. can we decide initial sweep axes? thinking ctx lengths [512,1024,2048], batch [1,4,8], quant [fp16,int8]. latency SLO target 80th p95 < 200ms at batch=1 for hosted tier. is that reasonable? :thinking_face:

devon: 200ms p95 for 2k ctx is aggressive on 8B-ish models but harbor9b might be okay with kernel tuning. recommend start with profiling runs to get baseline perf/kv-cache behavior.

maria: +1 to profiling. also add throughput pass for Dedicated sizing: sustained qps at batch 8 for ctx 512/1024. we need numbers for cost model.

nora: checklist proposal (short):
- perf baseline (fp16) ctx sweep 512/1024/2048, batch 1/4/8
- quant smoke (int8, int4-lite if supported) quality-run on 500 prompts (mix chat/sys/instr) -> key metrics: exact-match-ish + rouge/bertscore delta
- latency heatmap for prefix-heavy traffic (1-token warmup vs cold start)
- KV cache stress: long convo chains 4k tokens simulated
- canary rollout plan + fallback model variant
please comment on missing items.

sam: missing: memory regression checks for quant (OOM risk), and perf under concurrent streams (10/50/200 streams) for Dedicated. also add simple synthetic prompt for prefix cache hit ratio.

devon: putting quick commands I'll run on staging node (copy/paste):
```bash
# baseline fp16 sweep
run_bench --model harbor9b --dtype fp16 --ctx 512 --batch 1 --iters 200 --out baseline_512_b1.log
run_bench --model harbor9b --dtype fp16 --ctx 1024 --batch 1 --iters 200 --out baseline_1024_b1.log
run_bench --model harbor9b --dtype fp16 --ctx 2048 --batch 1 --iters 100 --out baseline_2048_b1.log

# quant smoke
run_bench --model harbor9b --dtype int8 --ctx 1024 --batch 1 --iters 100 --quant-verify --out quant_int8.log
```

benchbot: scheduled bench runs for tomorrow 03:00 UTC. job ids: 9872,9873,9874. I'll post logs when ready. :robot_face:

maria: for quality pass can QA run a subset of generative tests? @qa_ash can you do 500 prompt check + human spot-check 30 dialogs? give pass/fail criteria for int8 vs fp16 (no more than 3% drop on BERTScore and no critical hallucinations).

qa_ash: can do. will run eval harness and a small manual review. need sample prompt set — use "chat_core_500_v2" from evals repo?

nora: yes use "chat_core_500_v2". QA pass criteria:
- mean BERTScore delta <= 3% vs fp16 baseline
- critical hallucination rate <= 1.5%
- top-token logprob distribution sanity check (no massive degradation)
If any fail, we escalate to model-owner triage.

devon: quick note on metrics: collect token latency by position, memory RSS, per-kernel time breakdown, and kv cache hit ratio. add flags to run tool: `--trace-kernels --mem-sample 1s --kv-stats`.

sam: ops question: where to deploy canary? suggest eu-west-1 staging cluster (capacity isolated) with routing policy to send 2% of traffic. @ops-bot can you provision a canary pool (g4dn-like) and add autoscale buffer?

ops-bot: canary pool requested. provisioning 4x A100-sim nodes in eu-west-1 staging. ETA ~45m. will post endpoint when ready.

maria: timeline suggestion: perf smoke + quant smoke tomorrow morning, QA + manual review tomorrow afternoon, canary Friday AM if green.

nora: fine. owners: devon (benching), sam (SLO/traffic), maria (Dedicated sizing + cost calc), qa_ash (quality), ops-bot (canary infra). I'll collate results into a short triage doc after runs. thanks all :raised_hands:

benchbot: run 9872 finished: baseline_512_b1.log -> p95 45ms, 99th 90ms, throughput 120 tok/s.
benchbot: run 9873 finished: baseline_1024_b1.log -> p95 78ms, 99th 150ms, throughput 95 tok/s.
benchbot: run 9874 finished: baseline_2048_b1.log -> p95 210ms, 99th 380ms, throughput 60 tok/s.

sam: baseline looks promising except 2k ctx p95 is above SLO. need kernel tuning or fallback on ctx 1024 for latency-sensitive routes.\
qa_ash: quant_int8.log quality quick summary: mean BERTScore delta 2.1%, hallucination 0.9% on sample 500. manual spot-check passed on 30 dialogs (minor style shifts).\
nora: great — int8 smoke within thresholds. next actions:
- devon: try perf tuning to get 2k ctx p95 down (profiling + kernel hinting).
- sam: update routing to prefer 1024 while we optimize 2048 or provide a graceful degrade to fp16 on high-priority routes.
- maria: start Dedicated sizing calc from throughput numbers above.
- qa_ash: run extended quality regression with 2k ctx samples overnight (will post results).\
devon: started tracer run with `--trace-kernels`. early finding: attention matmul kernel spikes at 1800+ tokens, will try tiled attention patch. posting diff later.\
nora: thanks — keep updates here. if any regression or critical failure, mark thread with :rotating_light: and ping infra leads.

sam: noted. closing loop — will prepare SLO doc draft once devon posts tuned numbers. :memo:
